tok 1.0 "Room service"

pool hotel "The Evanstonian"
  lane manager "Room-service manager"
    start called "Guest calls room service"
    task take "Take down the order"
    and split
    task ticket "Submit the order ticket to the kitchen"
    xor alc "Order includes alcohol?"
    task giveorder "Give the order to the sommelier"
    xor altmerge
    task assign "Assign the order to the waiter"
  lane kitchen "Kitchen"
    task food "Prepare the food"
  lane sommelier "Sommelier"
    task wine "Fetch wine from the cellar"
    task bev "Prepare other alcoholic beverages"
  lane waiter "Waiter"
    task cart "Ready the cart"
    task drinks "Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"
    and join
    task deliver "Deliver the order to the guest's room"
    task ret "Return to the room-service station"
    task debit "Debit the guest's account"
    end done "Order completed"

flow called -> take -> split
flow split -> ticket
flow split -> alc
flow split -> assign
flow ticket -> food -> join
flow alc -> giveorder "yes"
flow alc -> altmerge "no"
flow giveorder -> wine -> bev -> altmerge
flow altmerge -> join
flow assign -> cart -> drinks -> join
flow join -> deliver -> ret -> debit -> done
